notes.title: "To Infinity and Beyond"
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=7qiRMZh7uAA;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://bit.ly/3cm8MVP]Visit Beat Stickman's homepage[/url]

[b]Beat Stickman: Beyond[/b] is the next game in the Beat Stickman franchise, and the store page is now live, you can start to add it to your wishlist.

If you own [b]Beat Stickman: Inifinity Clones[/b], you can buy [b]Beat Stickman: Beyond[/b] for a discounted price through bundles, which will be available when the game is released.

Here are some of the features of the new game that you will love:
[list]
[*][b]Bigger view: [/b]the game is designed especially for big-screen experience. Enjoy beating the Stickman on 100% of the space of your screen.
[*][b]Deeper stories: [/b]Go deeper into the original universe of Beat Stickman by collecting Stories, discover the plot. There will be in-game characters to interact with.
[*][b]Better weapons: [/b]Weapons now not only just increase their powers numerically but also evolve visually as you upgrade.
[/list]
And those are not even all that [b]Beat Stickman: Beyond[/b] is going to offer. Add the game to your wishlist and follow our social pages to get the latest news about the development progress, new gameplay videos, offers,...and more.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1494280

notes.title: Something new is coming...🤩
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ws3ykaK5jYQ

- New look
- New stickmans
- New weapons, this is big. Image the Wall, Saw, Tomato,...will be just slots which you can insert weapon cards that you own into. For instance, the Wall slot (will be renamed, something like "Slot 0"), you can insert the normal (current) Wall card to it or you will collect another cool card and insert to it, like a Supper Electric Wall,...That new design will enable us to add infinite weapons to the game.

Thank you for your support, we're trying our best to make the game better.

notes.title: Happy new year 2019!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33873228/79e7eb5268da761521631f88a8803d31877279c9.png[/img]

Happy new year 2019 to all of you and your families! We're very excited to announce the latest update to Beat Stickman, the last one of 2018 and also a big one.

[list]
[*] [b]Weapon's rank:[/b] upgrading your weapons is now more fun than ever. Weapon's levels are now organized into ranks and stars. Comes with that are new rewards, each time you reach a new rank or each time you level up when you reached the maxed rank.

[*] [b]Weapon's corruption:[/b] it goes without saying that nothing really lasts forever, neither do your weapons, sometimes it will be bugged. But that's actually a good thing because fixing them is just a matter of just a few clicks and the reward is big!

[*] [b]Timed bonus:[/b] sometimes there will be an icon appearing in the left, click it quickly (as it will only be there for a few seconds) to perform some kind of magic trick that you would definitely benefit largely.

[*] [b]Prestige:[/b] oh, and how about reset your progress just to start a new cycle with the more powerful weapons? Yes, now you can do it. Unlocking, upgrading weapons, collecting offline money, collecting hats,...all will give you Raw Dark Matter, which would be converted to Concentrated Dark Matter once you reset the game, and ultimately, Dark Matter is what boosts your weapon's power to a whole new level.

[*][b]AdCoin debris:[/b] as you already know, many activities in the game requires AdCoins. Currently, beside using microtransaction, you can earn it by leveling up, daily reward. And now, you can farm it, just click like you normally did to farm Debris, sometimes AdCoins will drop for you to collect as well.

[*][b]Blood trail:[/b] well, it's not exactly "blood", it's actually ketchup

[*][b]Lucky wheel effect:[/b] now you can hear the wheel moving, there's also confetti and some sound to congrats your win.

[*][b]Remove The Master:[/b] The Master has a good run, but it's retired now, that's also a good opportunity to extend new weapons in the future.

[*][b]Fixed achievements issue:[/b] now you can be sure that all the achievements you earned will be recorded!

[/list]

That isn't even all that you will get as Beat Stickman is still in development, more are coming.

Thank you all for playing the game.

Have a great year of 2019 ;)

ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Hat collector, macOS update and more...
notes.content:
[b]Good news for macOS gamers:[/b] you are up-to-date now!

The latest update has been available minutes ago, this time both Windows and macOS receive the update. We were experiencing a technical issue that made updating for macOS impossible. Now the problem is solved, and in the future, all the platforms will receive new updates at the same time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33873228/2a8bceda5a0df67a9317b22195564a2c6a989b3f.png[/img]

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Stickman loves hats! Sometimes it will wear a hat, and sometimes, as it takes damage, it will drop the hat. Just go ahead, collect it for currency reward and collection. In the future update, there may be a new leaderboard for who collect most hats (rarer hats will have the bigger score, of course).

[*]This update also fixed a bug with the Story that caused the storyline's text missing.

[*]From now on, you'll receive daily AdCoins for free.
[/list]

We're still actively working to improve Beat Stickman, all the feedbacks are very welcomed.
